dct_description_sm: The primary goal of wildlife investigations in the region since 1992 has been to describe the seasonal distribution and abundance of selected species before, during, and after construction of oil development projects. CPAI began producing oil on the Colville River delta in 2000 with the development of the CD-1 and CD-2 drill sites. Production was augmented in 2006 with construction of the CD-3 and CD-4 drill sites. CPAI has proposed additional oil and gas development sites in NE NPRA as part of the Alpine Satellite Development Project.
dct_title_s: Alpine Satellite Development Project, Alaska - Avian Studies
